segments.speaker: Leader
segments.text: Okay everyone, open to Romans chapter 8 and look at verse 28. We know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him.

segments.speaker: Sarah
segments.text: I always thought that meant everything is good, but Paul says works together, and later in verse 38 to 39 nothing can separate us.

segments.speaker: Leader
segments.text: Right. Second Corinthians 12:9 says my grace is sufficient for you. Think about how those two fit together.

segments.speaker: Tom
segments.text: I read 1 John 4:18 last night about perfect love casting out fear and it changed how I saw my week.

asks.question: What did Sarah say about Romans 8?
asks.answer: She used to think it meant everything is good, but noticed Paul says works together [00:30].
